missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Картина' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'висит'. 'Красивая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'на стене' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Картину' is the accusative direct object of 'написал'. 'Новую' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'художник' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Картины' is the genitive form after 'копия', showing of what. 'Известной' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Картине' is the dative form required by 'посвятить', marking what the exhibition is dedicated to. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Картиной' is the instrumental form required by 'восхищаться', expressing what was admired. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О картине' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to express the topic. 'Долго' adds duration to the discussion.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Картине' is the prepositional form after 'на', marking where the forest is depicted. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Картины' is the nominative plural subject of 'висят'. 'Старинные' agrees in the plural, and 'в музее' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantifier. 'Картин' is the genitive plural required by 'много'. 'Дорогих' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'в галерее' is the location.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Картины' is the genitive form required after the negation 'нет'. 'В зале' is the prepositional location.
